title: Castle Spinning Wheel
subtitle: Upright treadle wheel from the craftsmanspace.com plan, built to its drawings (mm)

notes.Leg: Foot sawn at 12°: 154 from the shoulder on the long (outer) side, 149 on the short. Tenon Ø18 x 39 goes up through the plank's 75° hole; wedge it across the grain, then trim flush. Only the two legs the treadle axle runs between get the Ø6 treadle-bar hole, drilled at assembly.
notes.Wheel Plank: Six planks, each 70° of the rim (R155 to R195 x 35); the 10° at each end laps over the next plank. The plan's view A shows a hooked lap; it is modelled as a bridle (13 tongue in 11 cheeks) with the same overlap. Drill the Ø6 pin through each lap at assembly. Two drive-band grooves round the outside.
notes.Hub: Ø6.5 axle hole, as section B-B; the axle's 6 mm square middle is driven into it. Six Ø16 x 20 sockets 34 from the crank-side end.
notes.Toggle: Ø16 x 20 tenons both ends: into the hub and into the rim plank.
notes.Main Pillar: Ø18 through for the holder's tenon; hooked slot for the wheel axle (bottom 233 from the tenon end) with the Ø8 axle-pin hole 9 above it; 21 x 55 window and Ø20 bore at the top for the movable bearing and the tension screw.
notes.Secondary Pillar: Same axle slot and Ø8 pin hole as the main pillar. Its Ø20 top tenon goes up through the holder; the shoulder meets the holder's underside.
notes.Main Holder: Ø18 x 72 tenon goes through the main pillar and is capped by a disc. Ø20 hole for the secondary pillar, Ø18 for the maidens 97 further on, Ø8 across it for the lock pin.
notes.Maidens: Head sawn to 12.3 thick at the top, flaring out on R70; R6.5 U slot for the flyer bearing, lined with the skin. Shaft Ø18 x 140 through the holder, the wool carrier and the second disc, locked by the D8 pin.
notes.Tension Knob: Screw 14.3 dia, 3.5 pitch (wood threadbox or lathe); the movable bearing gets the matching 12 mm tapped thread.
notes.Movable Bearing: Rides in the main pillar's window on the tension screw; the flyer axle's Ø4 tip runs in its Ø6 x 22 hole.
notes.Flyer: Arms are ellipses: outer semi-axes 125 x 69, inner 102 x 59. 22 thick at the knob tapering to 15 at the tips. Ø1 hook holes at the hole table's positions.
notes.Flyer Axle: M5 LEFT-hand thread for the whorl's nut.
notes.Rectangle Nut: M5 LEFT-hand, seated in the whorl's 12 x 12 x 10 pocket.
notes.Bobbin: Must turn freely on the flyer axle.
notes.Treadle Axle: Ø6 x 60 holes in both ends for the treadle bars. The 69° dovetail across the top takes the pedal, nailed in with two D2 nails.
notes.Treadle Pedal: Edges bevelled 62° over the 116 at the dovetail end to fit the treadle axle. The two Ø5 holes at the nose take the cord.
notes.Footman: Hangs from the rotation pin by its keyhole; the cord ties its foot to the pedal.
notes.Drive Band: One cord, crossed into a figure 8 and doubled: one loop runs on the whorl, the other on the bobbin.
notes.Wool Bar: The plan's drawings show it standing on the floor, leaning back 13° against the holder's front end, in front of the wool carrier rather than in the carrier's Ø16 hole (which only fits the bar's Ø16 ends). Modelled as drawn.
notes.Wool Carrier: Swings on the maidens' shaft: Ø19 hole on the maidens, Ø16 hole 155 further out.
notes.Excenter: The crank: axle and rotation-pin holes 35 apart (C shape R12.5 / R22.5, 3 thick).
notes.Axle Pin: Tapered 9 to 6, driven across the pillar above the wheel axle to keep it in its slot.
